name: order-cancelation
subject: Your investment has been cancelled
previewText: Your investment on Abundance has been cancelled

fields.heading: Investment cancelled
fields.body:
Hi {first_name},

You investment in {{BOND_NAME}} has been cancelled.

If you have already paid for your investment, the money has been refunded to your Abundance account balance. You can choose to invest again, or withdraw the money back to your nominated bank account.
